title: MemeX
tagline: MemeX is a DeFi Powered NFT Lottery. Users will stake $MEMEX to earn points to enter lottery drops.
description: At its core, MemeX is a DeFi platform that rewards its users with NFTs. We believe that with DeFi, users can attain valuable artwork they would not have previously. To mint NFTs, users can stake the $MEMEX token to accrue reward points. Once the user has accumulated enough points, they can enter a lottery to have a chance at winning rare NFT artwork.
how_its_made: We built out the UI with Next.JS & Ether.JS. For Build & Deploy we used Fleek. For tooling we used Node. For IPFS storage, we used NFT.STORAGE. We used Chainlink for the oracle that powers our lottery. The smart contracts were written in solidity with the brownie framework. We were very happy with the result of the platform as the team worked very hard to put together the individual components.
